meta.title: MacWallpaperPro: free live wallpapers for Mac
meta.description: Free, open-source live wallpapers for macOS. Browse community wallpapers that react to your cursor and install any of them in one click.
lang.label: Language
hero.title: Your desktop, alive.
hero.lede: Free live wallpapers for your Mac, made by a community of artists. Pick one, click Install, and your desktop starts moving.
hero.ctaNote: Free and open source. Requires macOS 15 or later.
hero.hint: This background is a live wallpaper. Move your cursor.
catd.cute: Soft colors, sleepy bunnies, sweet skies
catd.scifi: Neon cities and machines that hum
catd.space: Nebulae, black holes and drifting stars
show.title: Fresh from the community
show.lede: Hover a card to watch it run. Every wallpaper here is free.
show.empty: No wallpapers yet. Be the first to share one.
cute.lede: Strawberry-milk skies, bunny meadows and bubble gardens. The coziest corner of the community.
cats.title: Find your mood
feat.title: Built for the Mac you already have
feat.live.title: Really live
feat.live.body: Each wallpaper is a real-time scene that reacts to your cursor and clicks, not a looping video.
feat.displays.title: Every display
feat.displays.body: Run one wallpaper across all your screens, including external monitors.
feat.power.title: Easy on power
feat.power.body: Power saving mode and a one-click pause keep your battery and fans calm.
feat.safe.title: Safe by design
feat.safe.body: Every upload is reviewed by a moderator, signed by our server and verified on your Mac. Wallpapers can't reach the internet.
feat.extras.title: More than wallpapers
feat.extras.body: A custom menu bar, glowing window borders and window snapping come built in.
feat.free.title: Free, for real
feat.free.body: No subscriptions, no paywalls, no account to download. Open source under GPL-3.0.
steps.title: Up and running in a minute
steps.1.title: Download the app
steps.1.body: Get MacWallpaperPro for free and drag it into Applications.
steps.2.title: Browse the community
steps.2.body: Find a wallpaper you love here, or right inside the app.
steps.3.title: Install in one click
steps.3.body: Click Install. The app opens and your new wallpaper goes live.
oss.title: Open source, built in the open
oss.body: MacWallpaperPro is free software under GPL-3.0. Read the code, report a bug or send a pull request.
make.title: Make your own
make.body: A wallpaper is a single HTML file. If it runs in a browser, you can share it here.
faq.title: Questions, answered
faq.a1: Yes. The app and every wallpaper are free. This website shows a few ads to pay for hosting. The app never shows ads.
faq.a2: No. You only sign in if you want to upload your own wallpapers.
faq.q3: Which Macs does it work on?
faq.a3: Any Mac running macOS 15 or later.
faq.q4: Is it safe to install wallpapers made by strangers?
faq.a4: Every upload is reviewed before it's published. Wallpapers run in a locked sandbox with no internet access, and the app checks a signature and checksum before installing.
faq.a5: Live wallpapers use some power, like any animation. Turn on power saving in the app, or pause the wallpaper with one click whenever you like.
faq.q6: I clicked Install and nothing happened.
faq.a6: Install opens the MacWallpaperPro app. If you don't have it yet, download it, open it once, then click Install again.

up.title: Share a wallpaper
up.lede: Upload your live wallpaper. A moderator reviews it, then it's free for everyone.
up.signinBody: Accounts are only for creators. Downloading never needs one.
up.fileHint: One self-contained HTML file, up to 10 MB. Inline your CSS, JavaScript and images. Wallpapers can't load anything from the internet.

up.thumbHint: PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 2 MB. 1600 × 1000 looks best.

up.rule1: Make it yourself, or have the rights to share it.
up.rule2: No network requests, trackers or external scripts.
up.rule3: Keep it kind: nothing hateful, violent or explicit.

consent.title: Cookies and ads
consent.body: Ads keep this site free. If you accept, Google may use cookies to personalize them. You can change your choice anytime in Cookie settings.
privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: MacWallpaperPro is a free, open-source project. This page explains what this website collects and why. We keep it short because we collect very little.
privacy.collectBody: You can browse and download without an account. If you sign in to upload, we store the name, email address and profile picture that Google or GitHub shares with us, plus the wallpapers you upload. Our servers keep short-lived logs, such as IP addresses, to stop abuse.
privacy.cookiesBody: We set a cookie to remember your language, a cookie to remember your ad choice, and, only if you sign in, a session cookie. These are needed for the site to work.
privacy.adsBody: Some pages show ads from Google AdSense. Google and its partners may use cookies to show ads based on your visits to this and other websites. Until you accept, we ask Google to show only non-personalized ads. You can change your choice at any time.
privacy.adsPartner: How Google uses information from sites that use its services
privacy.appBody: The app shows no ads and needs no account. It contacts this website only to browse and download wallpapers. Installed wallpapers can't access the internet.
privacy.choicesBody: You can change your cookie choice below, clear cookies in your browser, or ask us to delete your account and uploads.
privacy.contactBody: Questions or deletion requests: open an issue on our GitHub repository.
